status.note: Cerebras Systems has been listed on Nasdaq as CBRS since its May 2026 IPO; its newsroom lists no acquisition of the company.

retention.quote: We do not retain inputs and outputs associated with our training, inference and chatbot Services.
retention.note: Privacy policy effective August 27, 2024; it adds that logs are deleted when no longer necessary to provide services, and the batch docs say batch results are retained for 7 days after completion.

zdr.quote: We do not retain inputs and outputs associated with our training, inference and chatbot Services.
zdr.note: The policy does not use the term zero data retention; the prompt caching docs call caching "fully ZDR-compliant".

training.quote: For clarity, the foregoing does not grant Cerebras the right to use Service Content for the purpose of training or fine-tuning models.

soc2.note: The trust centre lists SOC 2 as a label under Compliance with no sentence and no report type; documents are behind an access request.

attestations.note: The trust centre lists CCPA and GDPR beside SOC 2 under Compliance, which are laws rather than attestations.

regions.quote: March 11, 2025 — Sunnyvale, CA — Cerebras Systems, the pioneer in accelerating generative AI, today announced the launch of six new AI inference datacenters powered by Cerebras Wafer-Scale Engines.
regions.note: The value is the data centre list in that March 2025 release, where only the first three were marked online and the rest carried 2025 target quarters; no current first-party list was found.

funding.value: IPO of 30,000,000 Class A shares at $185.00 per share (May 2026)
funding.quote: SUNNYVALE, Calif., May 13, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Cerebras Systems Inc. (“Cerebras”) today announced the pricing of its initial public offering of an aggregate of 30,000,000 shares of its Class A common stock, at a public offering price of $185.00 per share.
funding.note: Public company (Nasdaq: CBRS); this is its IPO, not a private round.
